model.title: A resolution designating September 2026 as "National Spinal Cord Injury Awareness Month"

summary.text: The resolution would designate September 2026 as "National Spinal Cord Injury Awareness Month" to raise public awareness about spinal cord injuries and recognize efforts to support those affected by this condition.
